title: Emergency stop: a 40 mm red mushroom button (1 NC) in the motors' supply, on a JST XH plug

parts.mpn: OMRON A22E-M-01 emergency stop 40 mm red, 1 NC

circuit: The button's NC contact between the cell and the motor driver's VM: the plug's VBAT pin on VBAT, its VM pin on net MOTOR_VM with the driver's VM and its capacitors (circuit.ts estopPlug, motorSupplyNet), as wide as VBAT. Pressing it opens the motors' supply at once; the controller stays on (Eurobot General Rules 1.2 F.4.c tolerates that). The motor current keeps the contact above its 10 mA minimum load, which a logic-level sense line would not.
checks: mechanics/safety.ts: both motors stalled at the pack's full voltage within the contact's DC13 rating (1.5 A at 24 V); the pack within its 24 V; its plug on a board; its panel high enough that the 54.7 mm body clears the plate; its head over the plate.

rules.rule: Eurobot General Rules 1.2, F.4.c Emergency stop button
rules.where: p. 11-12: red, at least 20 mm across, on top, hit with a fist, stops the robot at once; may exceed the robot's height by 25 mm (F.3: to 375 mm)

open: The printed deck the button stands through (1 to 3 mm thick at the button, Omron p. 12) is not generated yet: py/chassis.py has no deck. Until it is, mechanics.safety.estop.at.zMm is where the team's own deck must put the panel.
